Question: types rubbish Trash Wheel collect per dumpster load, changed years? app lets analyst choose Trash Wheels, rubbish types range years. shows average number items per dumpster load changes time, wheel highest rubbish type, numbers behind chart.

title: Explore What Baltimore's Trash Wheels Collect
text: package includes trash_collections, data frame dumpster collections four Trash Wheels (Mister, Professor, Captain Gwynnda) 2014 2023. 6,951 rows: 993 dumpster collections, seven rubbish types. Item counts estimates based samples. missing count means rubbish type recorded, nothing collected, package never treats missing counts zero. Source: TidyTuesday, Trash Wheel Collection Data (2024-03-05), https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2024/2024-03-05. Original data: Mr. Trash Wheel Baltimore Healthy Harbor initiative, https://www.mrtrashwheel.com/. Preparation: data-raw/trash_collections.R downloads CSV, cleans names, parses dates reshapes data wide long. Run rebuild data/trash_collections.rda.
